artifacts.summary: 7-phase plan covering all three absorbed defects (focus-prompt threading, stop-after-forced-phase, per-run cycle budget with artifact-based admission) as one serialized change to the batch orchestrator engine plus a single documentation pass.

memory_candidates.content: When a bash+jq orchestrator must distinguish 'this key was never seeded' from 'this key was seeded and its queue has since been consumed to []', jq's `// default` cannot do it (it fires on null/false, not on an empty array). The durable fix is a sibling boolean marker map seeded with the same `//=` idempotence as the queue itself (e.g. `.forced_round_seeded[$t] //= true` beside `.force_phases_remaining[$t] //= $q`), then a three-way branch: queue non-empty / queue empty-and-marked / unmarked. The two-way `if length > 0 ... else fall through` shape silently conflates the last two.
